## GET /v1/sephora/availability - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns store-level stock for one Sephora sku near a coordinate. Each store has id, name, address, distance, and an in-stock flag. Pass the sku from GET /v1/sephora/product (currentSku.skuId) plus a lat,lng. Default radius is 50 miles.

**Use when** you have a sku from product detail and a lat,lng. National in-stock is already on GET /v1/sephora/product.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `sku` (required) - Sephora sku id, for example 2210581. Comes back on product detail as currentSku.skuId. · e.g. `2210581`
- `latitude` (optional, string) - Latitude. Use with longitude when you do not pass location_coordinate.
- `longitude` (optional, string) - Longitude. Use with latitude when you do not pass location_coordinate.
- `location_coordinate` (optional, string) - Latitude and longitude as lat,lng, for example 37.4418834,-122.1430195. · e.g. `37.4418834,-122.1430195`
- `radius` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Search radius in miles, 1 to 100. Default 50.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `location_coordinate`, `latitude`.
- `longitude` is a no-op without `latitude` - sending it alone is a free 400.

**Response** `Product` object at `data`, `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/Product.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.title` | Product title (seen in a sample response) |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page (seen in a sample response) |
| `product.availability` | Stock/availability string when surfaced (seen in a sample response) |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). (seen in a sample response) |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… (seen in a sample response) |

Also in the sample: `product` {description null, seller null, reviews_count null}; `product.price` {current null, original null, currency null}; `product.rating` {average null, count null}; `product.ext.store_inventory[]` {store_id string, store_name string, state string, in_stock boolean, quantity number}.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/sephora/availability" \
  --data-urlencode "sku=2210581" \
  --data-urlencode "location_coordinate=37.4418834,-122.1430195" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/sephora/brand/products - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns products from one Sephora brand, 60 per page, each with product id, title, brand, price, rating, and image. The brand total is exact (Gucci was 64). Pass the brand short name from GET /v1/sephora/brands, for example gucci.

**Use when** you want to walk a brand catalogue. Brand short names come from GET /v1/sephora/brands.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** page (native `page`) · ≈60/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/60) x 5 credits

**Query params**

- `id` (required) - Brand short name from GET /v1/sephora/brands, for example gucci or AAVRANI. · e.g. `gucci`
- `page` (optional, integer, min 1) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `page_size` (optional, integer, 1-60) - Products per page, 1 to 60. Default 60.
- `sort_by` (optional, enum: best_selling | top_rated | price_low | price_high | new) - Result ordering: best_selling (default), top_rated, price_low, price_high, or new. On a moisturizer keyword search, new returned the same ids as best_selling, so treat new as unverified.
- `min_price` (optional, integer, min 0) - Minimum list price in US dollars.
- `max_price` (optional, integer, min 0) - Maximum list price in US dollars.
- `min_rating` (optional, integer, 1-5) - Keep products whose average rating is at least this, 1 to 5.

## GET /v1/sephora/brands - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Sephora's brand directory: each brand's id, short name, and canonical URL. Feed a short name (gucci) into GET /v1/sephora/brand/products to walk that brand's products. 372 brands on the 2026-09-02 probe. Static reference data, so it is 1 credit and heavily cached.

**Use when** you want to discover brand short names, then feed one into GET /v1/sephora/brand/products.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** single page - The upstream returns the complete brand directory in one call (372 brands, verified live 2026-09-02) and exposes no page parameter.

**Response** `Analytics` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ brandId, shortName, targetUrl }` (inferred from a sample): {brandId string, shortName string, targetUrl string}.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/sephora/brands" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/sephora/categories - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Sephora's root browse taxonomy: each node's id, display name, and canonical URL. Feed a node id into GET /v1/sephora/category to walk that category's products, or into GET /v1/sephora/category/data for its children. Static reference data, so it is 1 credit and heavily cached.

**Use when** Use it as the entry point for category browsing. Feed a node id into category or category/data.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** single page - The upstream returns the complete root taxonomy in one call (13 of 13 nodes, verified live 2026-09-02) and exposes no page parameter.

**Response** `Analytics` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {categoryId string, displayName string, hasChildCategories boolean, hasDropdownMenu boolean, selectedThumbImage string, targetUrl string, thumbImage string}.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/sephora/categories" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/sephora/product - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns one Sephora US product: title, brand, description, list price, rating, review count, images, ingredients, size, and in-stock flag. Pass the P-number (P427414) or the full sephora.com/product URL. Optional sku pins a size or colour variant. Optional language is en-US, en-CA, or fr-CA. For written reviews call GET /v1/sephora/reviews with the same product id. For store stock call GET /v1/sephora/availability with the sku.

**Use when** you already have a product id (P427414) or a sephora.com/product URL. For discovery, start at search or category.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `product_id` (optional, string) - Sephora product id, the P-number at the end of a product URL: sephora.com/product/the-ordinary-deciem-natural-moisturizing-factors-ha-P427414 is product id P427414. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/sephora/search and GET /v1/sephora/category. · e.g. `P427414`
- `url` (optional, string) - Full Sephora product URL, for example https://www.sephora.com/product/the-ordinary-deciem-natural-moisturizing-factors-ha-P427414. The product id is extracted from the path.
- `sku` (optional, string) - Sephora sku id for a size or colour variant, for example 2210581. Comes back on search rows as currentSku.skuId and on product detail as currentSku.skuId.
- `language` (optional, enum: en-US | en-CA | fr-CA) - Copy locale: en-US (default), en-CA, or fr-CA.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `product_id`, `url`.

**Response** `Product` object at `data`, `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/Product.md))

|---|---|
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |

| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.description` |  |

## GET /v1/sephora/reviews - 5-9 credits (request-shaped)

Returns written customer reviews for a Sephora product, 10 per page by default, each with the full review text, star rating, title, reviewer nickname, submission date, and helpful-vote count. The review total is exact. Pass the returned cursor back until has_more is false. Optional sort_by: most_helpful, highest_rating, lowest_rating, oldest, newest. Optional rating keeps only that star value.

**Use when** you have a product id and need the review text. The star average is already on GET /v1/sephora/product.
**Cost** price moves with `label` · cache 300 s
**Pricing** 5 credits per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free.
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 10/page by default; set with `limit` · depth unknown · price per N items not proven

**Query params**

- `product_id` (optional, string) - Sephora product id, the P-number at the end of a product URL: sephora.com/product/the-ordinary-deciem-natural-moisturizing-factors-ha-P427414 is product id P427414. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/sephora/search and GET /v1/sephora/category. · e.g. `P427414`
- `url` (optional, string) - Full Sephora product URL, for example https://www.sephora.com/product/the-ordinary-deciem-natural-moisturizing-factors-ha-P427414. The product id is extracted from the path.
- `page` (optional, integer, min 1) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Reviews per page, 1 to 100. Default 10.
- `sort_by` (optional, enum: most_helpful | highest_rating | lowest_rating | oldest | newest) - Review ordering: most_helpful, highest_rating, lowest_rating, oldest, newest.
- `rating` (optional, integer, 1-5) - Keep only reviews with this star value, 1 to 5.
- **Shared controls** `label` (sentiment | issue | reports | incentivized | injection; paid: reports, incentivized, injection) · `label_evidence` · `reports` → [labels](api-overview.md#labels-relevance-and-quality)

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `product_id`, `url`.

**Response** `ReviewList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, review }` ([full schema](schemas/ReviewList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `review.text` | Full review body |
| `review.id` | Review ID (parsed from the review URL when not first-class) |
| `review.published_at` | Review creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string… |
| `computed.labels_evidence` | When 1, every labelled row also carries… (with `label_evidence=1`) |
| `review.entity_id` | ID of the reviewed entity… |
| `review.helpful_votes` | Helpful-vote count (Amazon; null elsewhere) |

+9 more (types in the full schema): `computed.labels` {incentivized, injection, issue, reports, sentiment}; `review` {title}; `review.author` {name, location}; `review.rating` {value}. Also in the sample: `review` {url null, verified boolean, source null, language null, original_language null, translated null}; `review.rating` {max number}; `review.author` {avatar_url null, url null, reviews_count null} (+2 more). Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.estimate`, `data.held_back`, `data.labels`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/sephora/reviews" \
  --data-urlencode "product_id=P427414" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/sephora/search - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns Sephora US products matching a keyword, 60 per page by default, each with product id, title, brand, price range, rating, review count, and image. Pagination is clean: page 2 of moisturizer had 60 new ids and zero overlap with page 1. A query that matches nothing is returned as an empty page and is not billed. min_rating is honoured. new sort returned the same ids as best_selling on the moisturizer probe, so prefer top_rated or price_low when you need a different order.

**Use when** you want to find products by name or ingredient. A query that matches nothing comes back empty and is not billed.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 60/page by default, max 60 · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/60) x 5 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keyword, for example moisturizer or niacinamide. · e.g. `moisturizer`
- `page` (optional, integer, min 1) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `page_size` (optional, integer, 1-60) - Products per page, 1 to 60. Default 60.
- `sort_by` (optional, enum: best_selling | top_rated | price_low | price_high | new) - Result ordering: best_selling (default), top_rated, price_low, price_high, or new. On a moisturizer keyword search, new returned the same ids as best_selling, so treat new as unverified.
- `min_rating` (optional, integer, 1-5) - Keep products whose average rating is at least this, 1 to 5.
- `min_price` (optional, integer, min 0) - Minimum list price in US dollars.
- `max_price` (optional, integer, min 0) - Maximum list price in US dollars.
- `is_new` (optional, boolean) - When true, keep products Sephora flags as new.
- `category_id` (optional, string) - Optional category id from GET /v1/sephora/categories to narrow the search.

## GET /v1/sephora/search/suggestions - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Sephora search autocomplete suggestions for a partial query, the same terms the search box shows, plus a few matching products. Optional language en-US, en-CA, or fr-CA; fr-CA returns French product names.

**Use when** you want to expand a keyword before you run search.

**Paging** single page - Fixed-window autocomplete: upstream returns one typeAheadTerms list and exposes no page parameter.

- `query` (required) - Partial search query to autocomplete, for example moistur. · e.g. `moistur`
- `language` (optional, enum: en-US | en-CA | fr-CA) - Copy locale: en-US (default), en-CA, or fr-CA.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ term }` (inferred from a sample): {term string}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/sephora/search/suggestions" \
  --data-urlencode "query=moistur" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/sephora/stores - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Sephora stores near a latitude,longitude pair, each with store id, name, full address, phone, coordinates, distance in miles, and weekly opening hours. Default radius is 50 miles. Store data changes rarely, so it is 1 credit and heavily cached.

**Use when** Use it as a store locator. Pass lat,lng as location_coordinate. Default radius is 50 miles.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** single page - The upstream returns one fixed set of nearby stores per coordinate (44 around Palo Alto at 50 miles, verified live 2026-09-02) and exposes no page parameter.

**Query params**

- `location_coordinate` (required) - Latitude and longitude as lat,lng, for example 37.4418834,-122.1430195. · e.g. `37.4418834,-122.1430195`
- `radius` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Search radius in miles, 1 to 100. Default 50.
